fields.description: First byte of the 48-byte save header; zero in a fresh save, consistent with a slot-0/presence marker.
fields.evidence: Logical EEPROM byte 0 of the 48-byte header region (rev8-logical 0x00..0x30 verified non-blank in samples/baseline.sav). Header bytes move through the EEPROM block routines FUN_080384b0 (read, 4 halfwords per call) and FUN_08038574 (write) via DMA engine FUN_08038430 to the EEPROM bus, bounded by the geometry config at _DAT_0803855c.
fields.name: save_slot

fields.description: Nonzero header validation word (921); no Schema v2 checksum algorithm over any header/data range reproduces it, so it is carried as an opaque scalar (custom scheme documented in SPEC.md).
fields.evidence: Logical EEPROM bytes 1..3 hold 0x0399 (921) in samples/baseline.sav rev8-logical view. Written by the save-init path through FUN_08038574/FUN_08038560 and verified on load by FUN_080386d4 inside the retry wrapper FUN_0803872c; DMA via FUN_08038430, geometry config _DAT_0803855c.
fields.name: save_code

fields.description: ROM-resident ASCII game tag identifying the save format version.
fields.evidence: Logical EEPROM bytes 3..15 read 'WANKO ver1.0' (12 chars) in samples/baseline.sav rev8-logical view, NUL-terminated at byte 15; the raw file bytes are the per-8-byte-block reversed form, which proves eeprom_rev8=true. Block I/O via FUN_080384b0/FUN_08038574 and DMA FUN_08038430; string compare on load via FUN_080386d4.
fields.name: title_string

fields.description: Zeroed header workspace dword 0 (fresh-save init writes zeros across header bytes 16..47).
fields.evidence: Logical EEPROM bytes 16..20 verified 0x00 in samples/baseline.sav rev8-logical view, inside the 48-byte initialized header (0x00..0x30, the only non-0xFF span besides 7 record blocks). Written through the 8-byte-block path FUN_08038574/FUN_08038560 via FUN_08038430; geometry config _DAT_0803855c.
fields.name: save_counter_0

fields.evidence: Logical EEPROM bytes 24..28 verified 0x00 in samples/baseline.sav rev8-logical view, inside the initialized 48-byte header. Block write path FUN_08038574/FUN_08038560 via DMA FUN_08038430; geometry config _DAT_0803855c.
fields.name: save_counter_1

fields.evidence: Logical EEPROM bytes 32..36 verified 0x00 in samples/baseline.sav rev8-logical view, inside the initialized 48-byte header. Block write path FUN_08038574/FUN_08038560 via DMA FUN_08038430; geometry config _DAT_0803855c.
fields.name: save_counter_2

fields.description: Zeroed header workspace dword 3 (last dword before the header ends exactly at 0x30).
fields.evidence: Logical EEPROM bytes 40..44 verified 0x00 in samples/baseline.sav rev8-logical view; header extent 0x00..0x30 confirmed by the return to 0xFF fill at 0x30. Block write path FUN_08038574/FUN_08038560 via DMA FUN_08038430; geometry config _DAT_0803855c.
fields.name: save_counter_3
